codename: The Chatbot Popup & Memory Hub Upgrade
title: Add VisarDialog for Chatbot Integration and Enhance Memory Hub Components
summary: This pre-release patch integrates the VISAR chatbot natively as a dynamic popup dialog and heavily expands the system's memory ecosystem with a structured multi-component hub.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Implemented the VisarDialog class to load and display the VISAR chatbot inside a dedicated, flexible popup interface.
Integrated a dedicated chatbot activation button in the left sidebar layout complete with tooltip indicators and callback tracking.
Created an arsenal of modular memory hub components, introducing a built-in To-Do List, Notes engine, and Reminders module.
Engineered the base API model wrapper to facilitate native interactions with Gemini AI, packing built-in error safety catches and localized usage examples.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Updated the primary Main Window layout execution parameters to natively track, position, and toggle the chatbot popup overlay layer.
Enhanced the Memory Tab interface layout by deploying a highly structured, symmetrical 2x4 grid system to cleanly isolate individual utility sub-components.

notes: An essential iteration in the v0.x branch that bridges the primary system UI directly to specialized sub-windows. Organizing the memory tools into a rigid 2x4 layout ensures clean scaling as additional localized data tools are developed.
